acceptanceCriteria: The daily-change-evidence-workflow spec states whether these two refusals are typed abstentions (visible NOT_PRODUCED, non-blocking) or blocking, with the reason.
A test covers the chosen behaviour for both codes.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the V1-0259 route (c) live run (PR #187) in a scratch repository. `corvint dogfood change` refused at prechange-impact with `unsupported-impact-repository` when the repository had no Go module, and with `unsupported-impact-path` for a change to a file at the module root. Both are independent of the no-intent declaration. Unlike `unsupported-impact-range`, neither is a typed abstention that leaves the report completable, so a non-Go adopter, or a change touching go.mod-level files, cannot reach complete: true.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0264: commit a92dda35,9ae2fe09; AC1: DCW-V0-025 specifies visible, nonblocking typed abstentions and their scope-limit rationale; AC2: TestDogfoodDailyPathCompletesWhenImpactRefusesTheRepositoryOrModuleRoot covers both codes through change/check/seal. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: dogfood: pre-change impact refuses a repository with no Go module and a change to a module-root file, so such adopters cannot complete the daily path
